known_limitations: This alpha candidate is unsupported, unsigned, and unpublished; publisher authenticity is not claimed.
No real Factorio Play route is accepted, including Factorio 2.1.14; current F100 through F210 evidence is limited to read-only version and help qualification.
Human CLI, TUI, WinForms, keyboard, screen-reader, High Contrast, and scaling acceptance is deferred to the beta gate.
Linux CLI and TUI are exploratory package previews, while GTK is a frontend-only prototype; none is part of the supported Windows alpha claim.
FacMan client and generated model surfaces are experimental engineering consumers; no installed or supported public FacMan 0.1 SDK is claimed.
Managed installation, network acquisition, self-update, server operation, macOS, web/service, and additional frontends are outside this alpha.
